== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The early slip deploys for 1 and retains Motti’s inherited Pilot icon. The later slip deploys for 3 and visibly adds Warrior. Both printed slips show a piloting bonus of 2, power and ability 3, forfeit 5, Force-Attuned and the same effects on Kuat Drive Yards and unique Star Destroyers.
